sources.title: Mergers: Commission opens in-depth investigation into proposed merger of Celanese's and Blackstone's acetate tow activities
sources.effective_period: 2017 proposed transaction; global acetate-tow market excluding China
sources.locator: Commission preliminary concerns and Companies and products
sources.note: Describes Blackstone's portfolio company Acetow as the tow business and ranks Acetow third globally excluding China. It does not state a 15% share.

sources.title: 市況俏 材料-KY業績添動能
sources.effective_period: Chairman statement made 2023-05-23; target stated at that time
sources.locator: Article paragraph beginning「王克璋說，因產業屬寡占市場」
sources.note: Reports a target to expand global share to above 7%, not 5%.

sources.title: 材料-KY擴大外售塑料級醋片 由3千增至5千片 營收比重攀上4成
sources.locator: Article paragraph beginning「材料醋片年產能2萬噸」
sources.note: Reports the company at about 2% global share for that report's context; does not disclose the share calculation method.

sources.title: Celanese and Blackstone to form joint venture in acetate tow
sources.note: SEC-filed announcement says Blackstone contributed its Rhodia Acetow business to the proposed JV and would own 30% of that JV; it does not establish a standalone 15% market share.

sources.title: Acetek Investor Presentation 1Q24
sources.note: Issuer presentation sets a five-year target to expand global acetate-tow market share to above 7%; it does not establish what an earlier target may have been.

已完成最多8輪聚焦檢索。找到市場集中度的佐證及不同日期的發行人市佔/目標資料，但未找到能將原句全部百分比綁定至同一期間、地理範圍及市佔分母的可靠來源；未驗證的原子主張保留為UNKNOWN。
2019年報導將競爭者列為 Celanese、Eastman、Solvay、Daicel，並報導公司約2%；其市佔分母與計算方法未說明。
2017年歐盟執委會的集中度判斷明確是全球市場 excluding China，不能直接等同包含中國的全球市場。
2017年資料中的 Blackstone 指其持有的 Acetow 業務或交易中的投資者，不足以證明 Blackstone 本身有獨立15%市佔。
2023年報導及2024年發行人簡報所列約5%當前市佔、逾7%目標等較晚數據，不可替代原句未註明期間的數值。
